content.text:
deleting files the lint hook sees no files staged:
```
→ lint-staged could not find any staged files.
⧗   --- input ---
fix(entire): entire skills should live in .agent not agent.
✖   subject may not end with full stop [subject-full-stop]

✖   found 1 problems, 0 warnings
ⓘ   Get help: https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/#what-is-commitlint

VITE+ - commit-msg script failed (code 1)
```

Files are staged (13 deletions). Two separate issues: the commit message ends with a period (commitlint rejects that), and lint-staged reports no staged files likely because `lint-staged` config only matches file patterns that don't include pure deletions or the `.md` glob excludes deleted-only paths. Let's just fix the message first.

content.input: {"command": "git log -1 --format=%B 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; cat .lintstagedrc* 2>/dev/null; grep -n \"lint-staged\" package.json", "explanation": "Check lint-staged config", "goal": "Find lint-staged config", "mode": "sync"}

content.text:
The actual failure is commitlint: your subject line `fix(entire): entire skills should live in .agent not agent.` ends with a period, which is disallowed. The "lint-staged could not find any staged files" line above it is just informational (you only staged deletions, nothing to lint) — not an error.

Fix by removing the trailing period from the commit message:

content.input: {"command": "git commit -m \"fix(entire): entire skills should live in .agent not agent\"", "explanation": "Commit with a message that doesn't end in a period", "goal": "Create commit without triggering commitlint full-stop rule", "mode": "sync"}

content.text: Committed successfully. The trailing period in the subject was the actual blocker; the "lint-staged could not find any staged files" line is expected/harmless when a commit only contains deletions.
